meta.title: 🔧 refactor(github): Optimize GitHub config validation
meta.body_summary: Moves GitHub config validation from per-request execution to module initialization, claiming reduced overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Devin refactored config validation to module init; maintainer closed PR within 22 minutes with no review or explanation.
